description.en: Emit macOS native notifications as the DeepSeek Harness app itself, bypassing silent drops of osascript notifications by signature checks; clicking a notification opens the related session, with sound fallback when the page is closed.
description.zh: 以 DeepSeek Harness 应用自身身份发出 macOS 原生通知（绕开 osascript 通知被系统签名校验静默丢弃的问题），点击通知跳转对应会话，页面关闭时自动回退声音提醒。
